text: When the causes of dharma and so forth are attained, the body, held in place by the force of impressions (samskaras), persists. Why does the destruction of the currently occurring dharma and adharma not take place? Because of its very current existence, it is destroyed in the next moment. Knowledge burns the future karma, and what is done by the current body is also [burned]. Therefore, due to the cessation of impressions, the body falls, and liberation is attained.
